appDescription: Controls a StarLog journey and prepares or plays music derived from its constellation.

function.name: CONTROL_STARLOG_JOURNEY
function.description: Starts, ends, or reports the state of a StarLog journey. Submission mode uses clearly identified REPLAY data.

sourceMode.description: The clearly identified submission demonstration data source.

function.name: PREPARE_CONSTELLATION_MUSIC
function.description: Opens arrangement settings for a confirmed constellation melody and requires user confirmation before generation.

constellationId.description: The identifier of a recorded constellation to arrange.

sourceMode.description: The data source that owns the constellation.

function.name: PLAY_CONSTELLATION_MUSIC
function.description: Plays the latest saved generated song for a recorded journey constellation.

constellationId.description: The identifier of a recorded constellation whose generated song should play.

sourceMode.description: The data source that owns the constellation.
